title: HierSum: A Global and Local Attention Mechanism for Video Summarization
abstract: arXiv:2504.18689v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Video summarization creates an abridged version (i.e., a summary) that provides a quick overview of the video while retaining pertinent information. In this work, we focus on summarizing instructional videos and propose a method for breaking down a video into meaningful segments, each corresponding to essential steps in the video. We propose **HierSum**, a hierarchical approach that integrates fine-grained local cues from subtitles with global contextual information provided by video-level instructions. Our approach utilizes the "most replayed" statistic as a supervisory signal to identify critical segments, thereby improving the effectiveness of the summary. We evaluate on benchmark datasets such as TVSum, BLiSS, Mr.HiSum, and the WikiHow test set, and show that HierSum consistently outperforms existing methods in key metrics such as F1-score and rank correlation. We also curate a new multi-modal dataset using WikiHow and EHow

translated_title: HierSum：一种用于视频摘要的全局与局部注意力机制
translated_abstract: 视频摘要旨在创建一个删节版本（即摘要），在保留相关信息的同时提供视频的快速概览。在本工作中，我们专注于教学视频的摘要，提出了一种将视频分解为有意义片段的方法，每个片段对应视频中的关键步骤。我们提出了**HierSum**，一种分层方法，将来自字幕的细粒度局部线索与视频级指令提供的全局上下文信息相整合。我们的方法利用“最常重放”统计作为监督信号来识别关键片段，从而提高摘要的有效性。我们在TVSum、BLiSS、Mr.HiSum和WikiHow测试集等基准数据集上进行评估，结果表明HierSum在F1分数和秩相关性等关键指标上始终优于现有方法。我们还利用WikiHow和EHow策划了一个新的多模态数据集。
tldr: HierSum提出了一种分层视频摘要方法，将字幕的细粒度局部线索与视频级指令的全局上下文相整合，并利用“最常重放”统计作为监督信号识别关键片段，在多个基准数据集上持续超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: HierSum is a hierarchical video summarization method that integrates fine-grained local subtitle cues with global video-level instruction context, leverages "most replayed" statistics as a supervisory signal to identify critical segments, and consistently outperforms existing methods across benchmark datasets.
